procedure: Remove digitized points where z > 0.5 AND H0 > 75.0
criterion: The KBC/MOND H0(z) curves converge to ~67.4 km/s/Mpc at high z. The maximum H0 in any KBC model is ~74.8 at z~0. At z > 0.5, all KBC models predict H0 < 70. Points with H0 > 75 at z > 0.5 are therefore outside the physically possible range and are identified as graphical artifacts (misread vector elements from axis labels or other curves). This is an objective amplitude cut, NOT a monotonicity assumption.
